acceptance_criteria: AC-1: `ai-catapult evolve --validate` implements WikiSkill Eq. 4 over recorded judgments: accept iff R(T_val,k) > R_best; early-stop iff R_best = 1.0 (weighted aggregate at rubric maximum); else revert to S_{k-1} and drop the overlay (master §3a, §6-B3). No threshold is cited to the paper (§3a boundary).

AC-2: Seeding honors F1 (master §4.9): S_0 = current catalog state and R_best = the current skill set's validation score — never a skill-disabled baseline; S_{k-1} = last accepted state; reject drops the overlay while the wiki keeps its learnings (append-only structurally, even on reject).

AC-3: Provenance is enforced (master §5.4): a judgment not bound to candidate_overlay_sha256 + task_set_version + judge_model is refused with judgment_unbound; unrecorded invocations surface as attribution gaps in the audit entry.

AC-4: Spend veto (master §5.5): recorded per-cycle cost_usd is summed and the gate refuses to dispatch or accept past $100/cycle with cycle_budget_exhausted; robustness prefers 3 samples + majority/mean within the ceiling.

AC-5: Unit vectors cover accept, reject, early-stop, revert, unbound-reject and budget-exhaust; a negative fixture (mutation) proves each refusal fires (§4.7). TDD evidence in .ai/evidence/tswc-ac-b3.json.
AC-6: The command is deterministic CLI machinery with no runtime LLM dependency (master §3d); judge calls stay out-of-band human runs (§4.4).

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Accept path: an accepted overlay flows as an atomic single-skill PR to the skills/ SSOT, then a skills.lock.json SHA bump, then revendor and per-host payload rebuilds (resolveBundledSkills, fail-closed) — the §3c pipeline direction, never in-place skill mutation.
AC-2: Reject path: the overlay is dropped and the wiki keeps its learnings; no upstream write occurs on reject (master §3c, §6-B4).
AC-3: The lock bump is a runtime action of the flow, batched per mega-plan §2.3; implementation-time scope excludes skills.lock.json and vendor/.

AC-4: E2E proof is a fixture run through the opencode-e2e-style harness (local fixture repo + stub upstream): the full accept flow and the reject flow both run green; red-leg fixture proves a broken handoff (e.g. mutated lock SHA) is refused (§4.7). TDD evidence in .ai/evidence/tswc-ac-b4.json.
